name: ntsc-rs
notes: 2026-11-27: Source: prospects/inbox/2026-11-20-discovery.md. Lead said version and licence unverified: release v0.9.7; ntscrs crate declares MIT OR ISC OR Apache-2.0 (permissive, not GPL). No crates.io CLI crate; the CLI ships as ntsc-rs-cli inside the macOS standalone pkg.

2026-11-27: Evidence from examples/ntsc-rs-vhs-preset: pkg pinned by SHA-256 and unpacked under output/, never installed. -c png failed with 'Failed to insert sink' in that bundle; FFV1 and H.264 worked.
2026-11-27: Skill: guide written at skills/ntsc-rs/SKILL.md from the fixture.

evidence.result: 10-frame 320x240 testsrc clip, flat JSON preset seed 1234 to FFV1: repeat run frame-identical, seed 4321 differs on 10/10 frames, PSNR vs source 12.7 dB, frame 5 inspected as smeared chroma and tracking band; OK.
evidence.scope: ntsc-rs-cli 0.9.7 headless from unpacked pkg, macOS arm64, FFV1 output; not the PNG route, GUI or plugins, other hosts or versions; hashes are same-host.

summary: Emulates the analogue signal path (NTSC composite, VHS tape, tracking noise, chroma bleed, head switching) on video. A command-line renderer takes JSON presets with a random seed.
use_when: Make clean generated footage look like VHS or broadcast tape with a repeatable seeded preset
Need signal-level artefacts, not just a filter overlay
avoid_when: Use frei0r or G'MIC for simple filter-style effects in an existing pipeline
Use libplacebo for display-side scaling and tone mapping, not tape artefacts

install.macos: Download ntsc-rs-macos-standalone.pkg from the GitHub release and unpack with pkgutil --expand-full; ntsc-rs-cli is inside the app bundle

assessment.rationale: A headless CLI with JSON presets and a seed exists and was fixture-tested; it fills the analogue-tape gap that frei0r, G'MIC and libplacebo leave. The code is permissive; the bundled GStreamer was not assessed.
